notes: All strains are thermally evolved isolates; 'Anc' (Anc_42CA3, itself a 42C-adapted ALE strain) is the parent the high-temperature lineages are compared against, so it is taken as reference genotype per the label notes, and Anc at 30 and 37 C as controls (debatable: it is an evolved strain). The ch:genotype/variation field says 'adapted at 42C' for Anc at 30C but 'adapted at 45.3C' for Anc at 37/44C (field inconsistency across samples, not title vs field). 44 C growth from adaptation passages -> heat, adapted; 30 C taken as a standard temperature (treatment none). Mutated genes not listed, so perturbed_genes/global_regulator left out for evolved strains. Culture mode not given (aerated tubes, shaking not stated).
